tex_content.html:
Definition
[Exterior cone condition] 1. ch8:8.27\group ch08-generalized-solutions The domain $\Omega $ satisfies an exterior cone condition at $x_0\in \partial \Omega $ when a finite right circular cone $V_{x_0}$ with vertex $x_0$ satisfies $\overline\Omega \cap V_{x_0}=\{ x_0\} $. It satisfies a uniform exterior cone condition on $T\subset \partial \Omega $ when these cones may be chosen congruent to one fixed cone.
